EFF 1.8.1
https://github.com/ssice-a/EFF
Imported from the EFF-1.8.1.zip supplied in this workspace.
License: AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE).

Vendored components: native compiler headers in src/, the original
eiem_author_core.cpp, tools/eff_author_sources.h, and tools/nativepack/*.py.
The author core and Python author tools are unmodified upstream sources.

Local header changes guard Windows pragma comment(lib) directives with
_WIN32 so the same resource compiler can be linked with the Android toolchain.
Android-specific portability adapters live outside this vendor tree, under
android/app/src/main/cpp/portable/.
